hypotheses.construction_plan: Substitute the named function and variable into the template M(f,K,x)=f(x)*K(x)*f(x), preserving the exact multiplication order; each additive term is reproduced by a different specialization of the same master function.
required_assumptions: f and K are unary functions applied to the same variable x

hypotheses.rationale: Both additive terms share the identical sandwich structure f(x)*kernel(x)*f(x), differing only in the function labels and variable names. A single master template with slots for the two functions and the variable explains the common structure without requiring V=W, G0=H0, or p=q.
